workflow: Monthly reconciliation of Stripe payouts against QuickBooks invoices to ensure all payments are accounted for and no discrepancies exist.
current_workaround: Download Stripe payout reports as CSV, manually import into Excel, compare against QuickBooks invoice data using VLOOKUP, then adjust entries in QuickBooks.
consequence: If not done, cash flow reports are inaccurate, delayed month-end close, and potential duplicate or missing revenue entries.

workflow: Cross-referencing Shopify inventory levels with NetSuite ERP records to maintain stock accuracy across sales channels.
trigger: Daily order fulfillment or when stock discrepancies are flagged
current_workaround: Export Shopify inventory CSV, upload to Google Sheets, manually compare against NetSuite item counts, then update the lower system to avoid overselling.
consequence: Overselling, stockouts, customer cancellations, and manual write-offs of inventory differences.

workflow: Transferring Salesforce lead data into Mailchimp for email campaigns because the native integration does not handle custom fields or update logic reliably.
trigger: Each new campaign launch or list segmentation
current_workaround: Export Salesforce report as CSV, map columns manually, import into Mailchimp, then flag duplicates and clean formatting errors.
consequence: Campaigns delayed, leads end up in wrong segments, and email send failures due to field mismatches.

workflow: Generating weekly SOC 2 compliance reports from log data that is spread across AWS CloudWatch, GitHub Actions, and a custom SIEM tool.
trigger: Weekly compliance review or auditor request
current_workaround: Query each system separately, download logs, paste into a master Excel workbook, format pivot tables, and send via email as PDF.
consequence: Reports are error-prone, audits take longer, and missing logs can lead to compliance gaps or failed audits.
